scope: CAD B5-D face-bound cylindrical blind and through Hole
checks: face-local center, diameter and blind/through depth create an exact cylindrical Boolean cut after Review
whole circular opening must remain on the planar source face; invalid or microscopic cuts reject atomically
Hole parameter edits and source translation/rotation regenerate measured volume and validity
missing exact face identity blocks STEP until explicit rebind; dependent work plane cannot be deleted
single-entry Undo/Redo, document v20 reload and actual STEP transfer
limitations: One face-normal cylindrical Hole per operation; threads, counterbore, countersink, slots and angled holes remain future work
Changed topology keys require explicit face rebind; unresolved results retain the last geometry for review
